name: bind_literals
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import glob,json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
from json.decoder import scanstring
LANE='/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-27/new-discoveries-batch2/new-twenty-2026-10-31/expanded-corpus-r536'
C='/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-27/new-discoveries-batch2/lanes/pi-mathdb-full-corpus-inventory-r301/corpus/mathdb-normalized-chunk-*.jsonl'
ids=[338609,366314,357028,351545,323671,369915,345692,347514,365840,368515,369373,370091,370309,363002,358546,355139,345691,335240,335260,335751]
idset=set(ids)
sha=lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
found={}
for f in sorted(glob.glob(C)):
    data=open(f,'rb').read()
    fh=sha(data)
    n=0
    pos=0
    while pos<len(data):
        nl=data.find(b'\n',pos)
        end=nl+1 if nl!=-1 else len(data)
        raw=data[pos:end]
        n+=1
        pos=end
        if not raw[:40].startswith(b'{"mathdb_id": '): continue
        mid=int(raw[14:40].split(b',',1)[0])
        if mid not in idset: continue
        rawtxt=raw.decode('utf-8')
        o=json.loads(rawtxt)
        assert o['mathdb_id']==mid
        key='"statement": '
        assert rawtxt.count(key)==1,mid
        s=rawtxt.index(key)+len(key)
        assert rawtxt[s]=='"'
        dec,e=scanstring(rawtxt,s+1)
        tok=rawtxt[s:e]
        assert dec==o['statement']
        found.setdefault(mid,[]).append(dict(mathdb_id=mid,chunk_path=f,chunk_sha256=fh,one_based_line=n,
            has_trailing_newline=raw.endswith(b'\n'),raw_line_bytes=len(raw),raw_line_with_newline_sha256=sha(raw),
            raw_line_without_newline_sha256=sha(raw.rstrip(b'\n')),raw_statement_token=tok,raw_statement_token_sha256=sha(tok.encode('utf-8')),
            decoded_statement=dec,decoded_statement_utf8_sha256=sha(dec.encode('utf-8')),
            title=o['title'],status=o['status'],post_type=o['post_type'],source_url=o['source_url'],source_name=o['source_name'],canonical_url=o['canonical_url'],references=o['references'],solutions=o['solutions'],solution_count=o['solution_count'],first_stated_year=o['first_stated_year'],lastmod=o['lastmod'],retrieval_source=o['retrieval_source'],has_formal_statement=o['has_formal_statement'],raw_line=rawtxt))
assert set(found)==idset, idset-set(found)
assert all(len(v)==1 for v in found.values()), {k:len(v) for k,v in found.items() if len(v)!=1}
out=[found[i][0] for i in ids]
payload=json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,indent=1)
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',LANE+'/write_lane.py','literals.json'],input=payload,text=True,capture_output=True)
print('WRITE',r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)
for x in out:
    print('=====',x['mathdb_id'],'|',x['title'],'|',x['status'],x['post_type'],x['first_stated_year'],'|',x['source_url'],'| src:',str(x['source_name'])[:100],'| line',x['chunk_path'][-10:],x['one_based_line'],'| sols',x['solution_count'])
    print(x['decoded_statement'])
    if x['solutions']: print('SOLUTIONS:',str(x['solutions'])[:600])
